edges.reason: block.timestamp gates the sale start and reveal conditions in mintAWhape.
msg.sender is the mint recipient and is forwarded into the safe-mint callback.
withdraw transfers the contract balance directly to msg.sender after the onlyOwner check.
reserveGiveaway mints to owner()/msg.sender under the onlyOwner restriction.
The mint loop calls _safeMint, which can invoke external receiver code.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient contract.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received call.
mintAWhape reads isSalePaused to block minting when paused.
mintAWhape compares block.timestamp against SALE_START_TIMESTAMP.
mintAWhape compares block.timestamp against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
mintAWhape writes startingIndexBlock when the sale concludes.
mintAWhape bounds totalSupply+numberOfWhapes against MAX_WHAPE_SUPPLY.
finalizeStartingIndex writes the computed startingIndex.
finalizeStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to derive the index.
finalizeStartingIndex derives entropy from blockhash values.
finalizeStartingIndex takes blockhash modulo MAX_WHAPE_SUPPLY.
setWhapePrice writes the salesPrice state variable.
withdraw performs an external value transfer to the owner.
The withdraw transfer sends funds to msg.sender.
withdraw is protected by onlyOwner which reads _owner.
setProvenanceHash reads and sets the isProvenanceSet guard.
setProvenanceHash writes ORIGINAL_PROVENANCE.
startSale sets isSalePaused to false.
pauseSale sets isSalePaused to true.
reserveGiveaway adds numberOfWhapes to totalSupply in its bounds check.
reserveGiveaway loops calling _safeMint.
getWhapePrice returns the salesPrice state variable.
getWhapeMaxAmount checks totalSupply against MAX_WHAPE_SUPPLY.
transferOwnership rewrites the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership uses msg.sender via the onlyOwner modifier.
numberOfWhapes parameter drives the mint loop in mintAWhape.
newPrice parameter is written to salesPrice.
baseURI parameter is passed to _setBaseURI.
_hash parameter is stored in ORIGINAL_PROVENANCE.
numberOfWhapes parameter controls the giveaway mint loop.
Local balance variable is the amount transferred by withdraw.
Local currentSupply caches totalSupply for the giveaway loop.
Local mintIndex is the token id passed to _safeMint.

normalization_plan.reason: The numberOfWhapes parameter has no independent semantics and is fully captured by the mintAWhape function's loop bounds.
newPrice is only meaningful as the assignment source inside setWhapePrice.
baseURI is only used to forward into _setBaseURI inside changeBaseURI.
_hash is only stored into ORIGINAL_PROVENANCE inside setProvenanceHash.
The giveaway count parameter is fully subsumed by the reserveGiveaway loop.
The balance local exists solely to feed the external transfer operation in withdraw.
currentSupply is a transient cache of totalSupply used only inside reserveGiveaway.
mintIndex is a per-iteration temporary fully contained within the mintAWhape loop.
